description: Sampann Utpadan India Limited manufactures and sells reclaimed rubber products in India. It operates through the Non-Conventional Energy and Reclaimed Rubber segments. The company offers crumb rubber, butyl reclaim rubber, and whole tire reclaim rubber, as well as bead wires, steel cut wire shot, and cut wires. It also generates power from wind and solar energy. The company was formerly known as S. E. Power Limited and changed its name to Sampann Utpadan India Limited in July 2023. Sampann Utpadan India Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is headquartered in Vadodara, India.
